in_marathi.name: Pavankumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom and Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pavankumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pavankumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Pavan' meaning 'God of Wind' and 'Kumar' meaning 'Young boy'. This name signifies a young boy blessed with the wisdom and strength of the God of Wind, Pavansut. It is a name of reverence and respect, reflecting the divine qualities of strength, wisdom, and purity.
